metadata.rationale: Zero-API design means cognitive insights are agent-written to local cache and loaded by the compiler, not fetched from external LLM APIs.
RepoScape is a CLI daemon + agent skill, not a standalone web app; the daemon orchestrates without external LLM calls.
WASM tree-sitter was chosen over regex for multi-language AST traversal; initParser handles local filesystem WASM loading to bypass browser fetch.
The WASM parser choice drives parseFile's tree-sitter-based syntax tree traversal for structural extraction.
D3-force for physics simulation combined with HTML5 Canvas for GPU-accelerated rendering was chosen over SVG/vis.js/3D to achieve 60FPS with 5000+ nodes.
Single npx reposcape command consolidates parsing, caching, watching, serving, and browser launch for frictionless developer UX.
Louvain is locked to seed 42 and resolution 1.0 for deterministic community detection, with Jaccard similarity matching for stable ID migration.
StabilizeCommunities implements Jaccard similarity mapping to maintain community color stability across compilations.
Path sandboxing validates every resolved file path against project root using fs.realpath to prevent symlink traversal attacks.
Each language implements a LanguageStrategy interface registered on ParserRegistry, avoiding monolithic parser spaghetti.
TypeScriptStrategy is one concrete implementation of the LanguageStrategy interface registered via ParserRegistry.
Cache directories are stamped with semantic version; on version mismatch, CLI clears cache and triggers clean re-scan to avoid schema errors.
A lightweight .lock file prevents multiple agents from clobbering cache writes; writers retry with random jitter up to 10 times.
Warm-start retains existing node physics states and places new nodes near parent coordinates with low alpha to avoid visual flashing.
Above 3000 nodes, the HUD dynamically aggregates communities into macro-nodes; double-click expands individual communities to keep physics load lightweight.
Focus events with TTL (default 60s) prevent stale highlights when the coding agent crashes; the daemon maintains a memory registrar.
On compile, the compiler maps all active files and prunes cached nodes whose source_file no longer exists on disk, preventing ghost nodes.
POST /api/insights/batch allows the agent to write hundreds of cognitive entities in one HTTP transaction, reducing N+1 file write overhead.
All AST and cognitive pipelines compile into a single JSON schema with nodes (id, label, file_type, source_file) and edges (source, target, relation, type).
WASM binaries are bundled locally in the npm package; initParser uses fs.promises.readFile for zero network dependency at runtime.
v4 mandated SKILL.md stays at repo root for npx skills resolver compatibility; daemon bootstrap code removed in favor of standard tool.
The --bootstrap / install-skills conditional block at daemon lines 187-192 must be removed entirely; bootstrapSkills is imported dynamically inside conditional, no top-level import to clean.
dist/server/bootstrap.js must be removed and npm run build re-run; stale build artifacts cannot be reachable from already-installed copies.
FileWatcher belongs to the deterministic telemetry layer (file watching, graph recompilation, WebSocket diffs). Agents should not manually notify RepoScape after every edit.
loadCognitiveInsights belongs to the agent cognition layer (document concept extraction, cognitive risk tagging). High-frequency events must not depend on LLM deciding to run shell commands.
Cognitive chunks must use the CognitiveEdge shape with source, target, relation, type, score, and optional metadata with rationale and source_doc.
validateCognitiveChunk must validate metadata shape when present and preserve it through load and broadcast; accept chunks without metadata for backward compatibility.
FocusEvent is an integration contract emitted by IDE extensions and harness wrappers. Agents may call POST /api/focus manually only for demos, user requests, or low-frequency milestones.
POST /api/insights/batch should clarify whether refresh was triggered; response should include refresh: queued or cache_only to remove ambiguity between cache writes and live updates.
HUD should only advertise what it implements (graph rendering, WebSocket updates, connection status, node selection, edge filtering). Future work like focus polling is documented but not claimed.
Direction B explicitly proposes changing makeNodeId from SHA256 hashing to normalized path strings to make IDs LLM-derivable without API lookup
Scoped subdirectory feature requires filtering watched paths and compiler target lists to specific directories
Scope config must dynamically filter chokidar watched paths inside the file watcher
Tour history requires atomic write helpers in cache.ts for saving/reading .reposcape/tours.json
Tour manager requires new REST endpoints GET/POST/DELETE /api/tours in routes.ts
TourManager component is proposed to live inside Sidebar.tsx as a new section
Direction B changes ID generation which includes both file IDs and node IDs in parser.ts
Direction C proposes server-side resolution of human-readable targets into Hash IDs during graph loading, which involves cognitive insight ingestion
Clustering runs server-side to keep single source of truth; frontend only derives client-dependent selection state via useMemo
Sidebar dot badge color must use the same palette mapping as canvas nodes - getCommunityColor must not redefine a separate palette
Community filter must preserve toggle semantics: selecting adds/removes from set, emptying set resets to null (All) - replacing existing numbered-pill filter
Panel 5 Detail Audit with incoming/outgoing neighbor lists enables fluid call-graph walkthroughs entirely from the sidebar, inspired by Sourcetrail
Sidebar derives community colors from the same palette canvas uses for node rendering, implying shared color derivation logic
Before re-parsing a modified file, the compiler must unlink all nodes and edges where source_file matches, ensuring in-memory graph reflects disk state.
fileExportsCache and fileImportsCache must persist in memory across compiles; only dirty files update caches, preventing barrel resolution degradation.
Edge key format unified to ${source}->${target}_${relation} globally across compiler, watcher diffing, WebSocket payload, and HUD state map.
CanvasRenderer must use the unified edge key format to correctly diff and render multi-relation edges without key collisions.
WebSocket client implements a watchdog timer on ping; if no pong within 5s, client closes socket and triggers exponential backoff reconnection.
High-frequency focus events should be emitted by IDE extensions and harness wrappers, not by agent SKILL.md shell commands. Agent only fires manual focus for milestones.
Daemon checks if project exceeds 500 source files or 2M words; prints warning with top subdirs and prompts user for scoped or whole-workspace scan.
Call resolution must first match local functions, then explicit imports, then fall back to global match only for unique non-generic labels, preventing thousands of false edges.
Cognitive edges should carry metadata with rationale and source_doc for honest audit trail; future HUD renders this in sidebar on COGNITIVE edge click.
Must construct undirected graph explicitly and sum bidirectional edge weights into single undirected edge for mathematically precise community modularity.
App.tsx must wipe query parameters from browser address bar via History API after extracting session token to prevent Referer header leak.
F0 blocks all subsequent features because renderer is destroyed/recreated on every diff, clearing pinnedNodes, highlightedNodes, lastFrameHash, and labelCache instance fields
App.tsx must split into two effects: mount-time renderer creation (deps []) and state-update ref push, with rendererRef for stable instance access

Singleton renderer means rebuildSimulation only adds nodes; removed nodes must be explicitly cleaned from nodePositions/nodeSizes/pinnedNodes or they become invisible hit areas and pollute fitToView bounding box
Cache key must NOT include font size because zoom-varying font would mint new entries every frame with ~0 hit rate, defeating the cache precisely when most needed (zoom >= 1.4)
When camera velocity drops below 0.01, snap to target position to avoid infinite micro-oscillation from spring damping
initParser must resolve web-tree-sitter core runtime at correct path and abort with non-zero exit code on any failure, not silently serve empty graph.
assertParserReady checks non-null parser, loaded language count > 0, and grammar-bound smoke test parsing const x = 1; to verify tree-sitter grammar binding.
Compiler resolution pass runs after all files parsed; replaces resolveBarrelImports with single pass that resolves module specifiers through ModuleResolver and unwrapReexports.
unwrapReexports is called with actual imported binding, not hardcoded placeholder; named, rename, and star branches all become reachable.
TypeScriptStrategy.parse must include rawImports with discriminated union over importKind (side-effect, default, named, namespace, type-default, type-named).
ModuleResolver.resolve follows strict 6-step pipeline: path-alias rewrite, relative resolution, ESM .js rewrite, extension/index fallback, sandbox check, unresolved fallthrough.
tryCandidate implements the extension/index fallback (step 4) and sandbox check (step 5) for each absolute filesystem candidate.
The resolution pass populates fileBindings replacing over-broad fileImports; only explicitly imported names are eligible for call resolution.
updateExportsCache must resolve each entry.sourceFile through ModuleResolver before storing; raw specifiers are dropped if resolution returns null.
TypeScriptStrategy must read export_specifier children via childForFieldName name/alias, not positional find; positional access is brittle against grammar revisions.
compileAndDiff is a thin transaction wrapper that snapshots graph, calls compileInternal (not compile to avoid self-deadlock), and diffs. Only one enqueue per public call.
snapshotGraph must use structuredClone because compileInternal mutates nodes in-place; shallow snapshot causes diff to see zero updatedNodes.
handleEvent must record intent (pendingChanges/pendingDeletes) and call compileAndDiff on flush; must not call compiler.handleFileDelete directly to eliminate double-eviction race.
The transactionQueue ensures only one enqueue per public call; watchers and /api/insights/batch must not snapshot state outside a transaction.
checkCacheVersion must delete only .reposcape/cache/, never .reposcape/insights/ which is user data. Migration recipe moves legacy cache/insights to insights/ with mtime collision resolution.
reconciliationScan reads cognitive chunks from the new .reposcape/insights/ path, not the old cache/insights/ path.
Stabilized communities map serialized to .reposcape/cache/communities.json at end of every compile and loaded back at init; deterministic lexicographic ordering for test equality.
Load persisted communities at compiler.init before first compile so stabilizeCommunities has a real anchor for Jaccard mapping instead of starting from empty.
security.ts exposes unlinkStaleToken; daemon must call it before invoking project-size guard so any token from prior aborted run is gone.
On guard proceed:true, daemon calls generateSessionToken and proceeds to listen; on proceed:false no token generated and daemon exits 0.
daemon.ts orchestrates token lifecycle; compiler must not touch .session-token - that is a cross-layer leak v3 explicitly closes.
GENERIC_LABELS entries must be stored lowercase and lookup key lowercased; current camelCase entries silently miss every camelCase generic call.
resolveBindingToNode helper resolves default exports via defaultExports map and named exports via case-insensitive symbol lookup in localFunctions.
Ad-hoc O(n^2) force pass in render must be removed; d3-force simulation runs in dedicated loop at 30Hz, render loop reads positions but does not mutate them.
Camera zoom/pan must not wake the simulation; layout is world-space, camera changes are viewport-only projection.
updateCamera must accept dtMs and scale forces by dtMs/16.67 to remove 144Hz vs 60Hz oscillation difference.
handleFocus must track every setTimeout in ref-backed Set and clear them in effect cleanup; long-running sessions leak one timer per focus event in v2.
findEdgeAt must iterate over every edge type with per-type gate against persisted currentOptions.show*; toggled-off edges are non-interactive.
Must use bounded concurrency pool (min of 8, cpus) with short-circuit semantics; Promise.all is not acceptable as it has no concurrency cap.
Lock retry ceiling raised from 10 to 30 attempts (~3s worst case); on exhaustion return per-entry failure, not in-process deferred-retry queue.
sandboxPath error messages must not echo user-supplied input verbatim; log sha256(input).slice(0,12) and resolved path only.
FileExtractionCache must carry rawImports and defaultExportNodeId; warm-restart rehydration must restore all fields into same accumulators as fresh parses.
fileExportsCache is part of the derived parser output contract; must be populated from rawExports during parse for downstream resolution.
resolveBindingToNode uses defaultExports map (file->nodeId) for default export resolution; built per-file during parsing from export default declarations.
defaultExports index maps files to their default export node IDs, used by both import edge unwrap and call-graph binding resolution.
SKILL.md moved to skills/reposcape/ to isolate skill source from the full Node app; prevents npx skills add ./ from copying node_modules and recursing into its own output.
Canvas GPU-accelerated rendering easily handles 5000+ nodes at 60 FPS vs SVG/DOM which drops to single digits above 800-1000 nodes
Jaccard similarity Hungarian greedy alignment maps new community IDs to historical max-intersection IDs, preventing complete recoloring on incremental changes
Deterministic seed (42) locks Louvain to prevent stochastic drift across consecutive compilations
RepoScape acts as live companion streaming diffs via WebSocket, auto-gliding camera and highlighting modified nodes in real time
Timing-safe comparison eliminates side-channel timing attack vulnerabilities during session token comparison
SandboxPath resolves physical symlinks recursively to prevent path-traversal vulnerabilities exposing system files
Stale lock checking prevents permanent process hanging when lock files remain after unexpected daemon terminations
Iterative traversal emulating DFS on the heap prevents Node.js RangeError on deeply coupled networks with circular dependencies
Seeded RNG with seed 42 guarantees 100% determinism for absolute reproducibility of community assignments
All compile and mutation requests must be serialized through a central async queue to prevent data race conditions and guarantee in-memory graph consistency
100ms debounce window prevents Chokidar storms during git checkout/branch switch from flooding the mutation queue and causing HUD latency stutters
5 MiB cap with 3 historic backups prevents error.log from growing indefinitely and consuming local disk storage
Loading WASM runtimes from local buffers prevents browser fetch() polyfill failures
Strategy pattern decouples multi-language parsing rules from core compilation files
5-sigma cutoff with minimum 50 links ensures high-degree structural nodes do not clutter D3 simulation with thousands of visual spring lines
Resolves imports through barrel directories with symbol renaming to prevent tracking breaks across re-export chains
Tier 1 triggers incremental compile on git HEAD change; Tier 2 triggers complete cache flush on schema version mismatch
Agent writes cognitive JSON directly to local cache instead of making independent API calls, requiring the compiler to load from .reposcape/cache/insights/
50-attempt cap prevents infinite reconnect loops on permanent offline; exponential backoff capped at 16s
validateCognitiveChunk checks source_file for path traversal (.. or absolute paths) but never opens the file directly - sandbox contract
